text_simplified: The prophets hastened to raise their children and check on their conditions. Ya'qub (peace be upon him) asked his sons at his death about what they would worship after him, and Ibrahim and Isma'il (peace be upon them) prayed that Allah make from their offspring a Muslim nation. The author transmitted Ibn Kathir's saying that part of the completeness of love of Allah is that a servant loves that from his own loins there be someone who worships Him. The early Muslims took intense care in raising their children. The author regrets those who limit their care to sons while excluding daughters, since the trust is one, the daughter is the mother of the future, and neglecting her upbringing is a blow to the Muslim society.
